【Cámara de salpicadero de 1.47" 1080P HD con tarjeta SD de 32 GB】
Esta cámara de salpicadero USB de 1080P HD capturará secuencias de vídeo e imágenes nítidas tanto en condiciones de conducción nocturna con poca luz como con una visión de gran angular extragrande, ofreciendo un ángulo suficiente para cubrir múltiples carriles y capturar más eventos. Gracias a la tarjeta de 32 GB incluida, no necesitarás almacenamiento adicional de la radio Android de tu coche. Introduce la tarjeta SD en la ranura lateral.
【WiFi integrado】
Puedes descargar la aplicación "Viidure" desde Google Play Store o Apple App Store. Esto te permitirá descargar los vídeos grabados directamente en tu smartphone para luego compartirlos fácilmente en las redes sociales con amigos y familiares.
【Grabación en bucle y sensor G】
La grabación en bucle sin interrupciones graba automáticamente sobre el archivo más antiguo de la tarjeta SD cuando esta se llena. En combinación con el sensor de gravedad automático, la cámara de salpicadero (delantera y trasera) "bloqueará" la grabación si se detecta una sacudida significativa o una colisión del vehículo. Esto garantiza que la grabación se guarde en la tarjeta SD y no se sobrescriba.
【Cámara de salpicadero con visión nocturna para coches】
Este grabador de conducción con visión nocturna ultranítida te proporcionará una excelente experiencia de vídeo en alta definición.
【Ángulo de visión amplio de 170°】
Equipada con una lente de gran angular extragrande de 170°, esta cámara USB para coche puede capturar incidentes con extrema claridad en un amplio ángulo de visión de la carretera, guardando la evidencia de inmediato. El campo de visión es más amplio y se eliminan los puntos ciegos.
【Fácil instalación y funcionamiento】
Este grabador de conducción USB puede alimentarse a través de las radios Android para coche mediante una conexión USB. Puedes ver los archivos grabados en una pantalla táctil HD más grande en cualquier momento. Esta cámara DVR para coche es apta para todos los vehículos de 12V CC y se monta fácilmente en el parabrisas. Viene equipada con un cable de extensión de 3.5 metros, una longitud adecuada para la instalación en la mayoría de los modelos de vehículos.
dasaita-usb-dvr-on-dash-camera-con-wifi-.translation:
Dashboard camera 1.47" 1080P HD with 32 GB SD card
This USB dashboard camera 1080P HD will capture sharp video and images both in low light night driving conditions and with an extra wide-angle view, providing enough angle to cover multiple lanes and capture more events. Thanks to the included 32 GB SD card, you won't need additional storage from your car's Android radio. Insert the SD card into the side slot.
Built-in WiFi
You can download the "Viidure" app from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store. This will allow you to download recorded videos directly to your smartphone to easily share them on social media with friends and family.
Loop recording and G sensor
The uninterrupted loop recording automatically overwrites the oldest file on the SD card when it is full. In combination with the automatic gravity sensor, the dashboard camera (front and rear) will "lock" the recording if significant shaking or a vehicle collision is detected. This ensures that the recording is saved on the SD card and is not overwritten.
Night vision dashboard camera for cars
This ultra-clear night vision dash cam will provide you with an excellent high-definition video experience.
Wide viewing angle of 170°
Equipped with an extra wide-angle lens of 170°, this USB car camera can capture incidents with extreme clarity over a wide field of view of the road, preserving evidence immediately. The field of view is wider and blind spots are eliminated.
Easy installation and operation
This USB driving recorder can be powered through Android car radios via a USB connection. You can view the recorded files on a larger HD touchscreen at any time. This car DVR camera is suitable for all 12V DC vehicles and mounts easily on the windshield. It comes equipped with a 3.5 meter extension cable, a suitable length for installation in most vehicle models.

Compatibility

  • Jeep Patriot 2011–2017

  • Before ordering, ensure that the shape, dimensions, and connectors of the original console match those shown for this unit.

Display and construction

  • Integrated IPS/Incell touchscreen.

  • Size indicated in the main sheet: 10”.

  • In the basic function description from the manufacturer, a 10,1” display is also indicated, so the size depends on the selected configuration.

  • Resolution: 1280 × 720 pixels.

  • Incell technology provides deeper blacks with the screen off and more vivid and natural colors compared to conventional Oncell displays.

  • Material: plastic and metal.

  • Format: Double DIN / 2 DIN.

  • Output type: color.

  • Indicated weight: 1,7, without a unit specified by the manufacturer.

Android, processor, and memory

  • Android 14.

  • Google GMS and CTS certification indicated by the manufacturer.

  • Qualcomm Snapdragon 6115 Octa-Core processor up to 2,0 GHz.

  • 11 nm manufacturing process.

  • Architecture indicated for Snapdragon 6115: 4 high-performance A73 cores + 4 A53 cores.

  • In another section of the data sheet, chipset 4 × A37 + 4 × A53 is also indicated.

  • Main configuration: 8 GB RAM + 128 GB ROM.

  • The range also includes 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 6 / 8 GB of RAM and 16 / 32 / 64 / 128 GB of storage depending on the version.

  • Maximum external memory indicated: 256 GB.

  • Power supply: 12 V.

CarPlay and Android Auto

  • Wireless Apple CarPlay.

  • Wired and wireless Android Auto.

  • The compatible 8core configurations allow synchronizing phone, music, navigation, calls, and messages.

  • Enables using voice commands for music, navigation, calls, and compatible messaging.

GPS and navigation

  • Integrated GPS.

  • Pre-installed offline maps with free updates.

  • Compatible with Google Maps | Here WeGo | iGO | Waze | Navitel | Sygic | Yandex.

  • Online maps require a connection via Wi-Fi or 4G LTE.

  • It is possible to download local maps for offline navigation.

Wi-Fi, 4G, and connectivity

  • Wi-Fi 6.

  • Compatible with Wi-Fi 2,4 GHz and 5 GHz.

  • Connection via Wi-Fi hotspot.

  • Bluetooth Tethering for low-energy connections.

  • USB Network Tethering.

  • 4G network via SIM card in compatible configurations.

  • The 4G versions include a SIM slot and 4G antenna.

  • The SIM card must be inserted before powering on the unit.

  • Not all 8core configurations include 4G connectivity.

  • CloudSIM service available depending on configuration.

  • The manufacturer indicates 10 GB of free data during the first month with CloudSIM.

Bluetooth 5.4

  • Next-generation Bluetooth 5.4.

  • Stable and efficient connection.

  • Lower energy consumption during wireless transmission.

  • Optimized decoding algorithms to enhance music and calls.

  • The manufacturer claims superior performance over previous Bluetooth generations.

DSP and Hi-Fi system

  • DSP available depending on configuration.

  • Higher 8core configurations use AKM AK7738 DSP.

  • Professional 32 band equalizer.

  • Adjustments from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.

  • Allows saving and importing different custom EQ settings.

  • Audio configuration 5.1 channels.

  • RCA output 5.1.

  • Output of up to 5 V RMS as indicated by the manufacturer.

  • Compatible with DSD audio formats and other lossless formats.

  • Three NE5532 operational amplifiers.

  • TDA7851 amplifier.

  • Maximum power: 4 × 50 W.

  • Total harmonic distortion THD indicated: up to 0,01 %.

  • Typical signal-to-noise ratio indicated: 98 dB.

Filters and acoustic adjustment

  • HPF High Pass Filter.

  • LPF Low Pass Filter.

  • Allows individual filtering of the signal from different channels.

  • Designed to achieve cleaner reproduction and reduce unwanted noise.

  • Dynamic Digital Bass to dynamically reinforce low frequencies.

  • Processing adjusts bass intensity based on content and volume while maintaining balance and clarity.

  • Speaker delay adjustment.

  • Allows modification of the timing of the four speakers to improve acoustic positioning and create an immersive feeling.

Radio

  • RDS Radio.

  • Professional NXP TEF6686 chip in higher 8core configurations.

  • Designed to provide stable and clear reception.

  • Noise-limited sensitivity as indicated by the manufacturer: -5 dBμV to -30 dB.

  • Optimization to maintain reception in environments with weak signals or high electromagnetic interference.

  • Online radio via Internet connection.

  • Online radio requires additional activation when used with the corresponding AI package.

AI Voice Control

  • Compatible with AI Voice Control Pro.

  • Requires additional activation code.

  • Allows controlling compatible functions hands-free.

  • Compatible with 9 voice/language variants: American English | Arabic | German | Spanish | Mexican Spanish | French | Italian | Brazilian Portuguese | Portuguese.

  • With Internet connection allows control of functions such as online music, online navigation, and YouTube playback according to compatible services.

Interface

  • Interface with day and night mode.

  • The system changes the main screens and sub-screens to reduce brightness during night driving and improve visibility during the day.

  • Multiple interface themes available.

  • Touch functions via gestures.

  • Gestures can be used for quick accesses such as returning to the main menu and adjusting volume.

Split Screen

  • Split screen to use two functions simultaneously.

  • Allows, for example, navigation on the left and music on the right.

  • Designed to combine navigation and entertainment without having to constantly switch applications.

Steering wheel controls and CANBUS

  • Compatible with most original steering wheel controls.

  • Allows changing songs and stations, adjusting volume, and answering calls through compatible controls.

  • Compatible with CANBUS.

  • Effective function preservation depends on the vehicle and selected wiring.

Plug & Play

  • Pin to Pin power cable.

  • Plug & Play installation in compatible vehicles and configurations.

  • No need to modify wiring when connectors match the originals.

  • If the vehicle uses connectors different from the supplied ones, a specific adapter will need to be requested.

  • Professional installation is recommended.

  • The manufacturer does not include a full installation manual, except for documentation related to the rear camera.

  • Assistance for installation can be requested.

Rear camera

  • Rear view camera input.

  • Compatible with image up to 1920 × 1080 pixels.

  • Allows viewing rear areas that are normally out of the driver’s visual field.

  • Adjustable vertical rear reference lines.

  • Rear camera available as an additional accessory.

  • High-efficiency image sensors indicated for obtaining a clear and detailed image.

Panoramic camera 360°

  • Panoramic AHD 1080P camera available only in the specific 8core configuration prepared for 360° system.

  • Panoramic view while driving.

  • Automatic cyclic recording after start-up.

  • Segmented recording with automatic overwriting of the oldest files when memory fills up.

  • Automatic calibration system.

  • Parameters can be configured directly from the unit without using calibration sheets.

  • Side cameras designed for ease of installation.

  • The manufacturer indicates that drilling or disassembly of door panels is not required with the specific system provided.

DVR and ADAS

  • Compatible with AHD 1080P DVR.

  • ADAS function available via optional DVR camera.

  • Loop video recording.

  • When the memory is full, the oldest videos are automatically overwritten except for saved emergency files.

  • The DVR must be purchased separately.

Remote monitoring

  • Vehicle tracking to check the route taken from the phone at a given moment.

  • Parking location to view the vehicle's position.

  • Geofence with notification to the phone when the vehicle leaves the configured area.

  • AI Security to check the vehicle's surroundings.

  • Ability to take photos via the DVR when the unit is powered on.

  • These functions require 1080P DVR and a unit equipped with 4G connection.

USB

  • Compatible with 3 simultaneous USB ports.

  • Ability to connect devices such as USB memory, DVR, DAB+, and TPMS simultaneously, up to three compatible devices.

  • Indicated USB storage capacity: up to 2 TB.

TPMS

  • Compatible with tire pressure monitoring system.

  • Allows monitoring the pressure of all four tires via compatible accessory.

  • Can help detect insufficient pressure or imbalances between tires.

  • TPMS available separately.

DAB+

  • Compatible with DAB+ Box.

  • Allows you to receive digital radio programs.

  • Search and change stations directly from the touchscreen.

  • The unit can electrically power the connected DAB+ Box.

  • DAB+ module available separately.

OBD2

  • Compatible with OBD Box.

  • Allows access to vehicle diagnostic information and helps identify certain faults.

  • OBD adapter available separately.

Cooling

  • Cooling fan controllable automatically or manually.

  • In automatic mode, the system activates the fan when the CPU temperature exceeds approximately 50 °C.

  • It automatically turns off when the temperature falls below the indicated threshold.

Digital outputs

  • The 8core higher configurations include optical and coaxial connection.

  • Availability depends on the selected configuration.

Multimedia formats

  • MP3 | MP4 | WMA | JPEG.

  • Compatible with multimedia playback and lossless audio formats in compatible configurations.

  • No integrated CD player.

Optional accessories

  • AI Voice Control | DVR ADAS 1080P Camera | Rear Camera | Panoramic Camera 360° | TPMS | OBD2 | External Microphone | RCA Cable | DAB+ Box | Specific wiring adapters.

Languages

  • Simplified Chinese | Arabic | Irish | Estonian | Belarusian | Bulgarian | Polish | German | Russian | French | Filipino | Finnish | Korean | Dutch | Croatian | Latvian | Lithuanian | Romanian | Maltese | Macedonian | Portuguese | Serbian | Slovak | Thai | Ukrainian | Greek | Hungarian | Italian | English | Vietnamese.

Certifications and quality control

  • CE and FCC certifications.

  • The manufacturer indicates that all units pass quality control before shipping.

FAQ:
1.How can I determine if my car model is suitable?
Please click on the product link to view the page and confirm the model year first. Check if the central control image of the car matches your vehicle and the attentions in the page. If it is suitable, please feel assured to make the purchase. If you are unable to confirm, please contact our customer service for assistance.

2.Why can't turn on the car radio ?
2.1 Please check the Voltage of car radio : 12V
2.2 When you test this car radio,you can combine the red and yellow wires and connect them to the positive side of the power supply.Black line to negative power supply.
2.3Replace the same type of insurance to test the car radio. Note: Please must use our power cables to connect our car radio,it is not possible to insert the original car plug directly into our machine.

3.Why the car radio will show "No Signal" when we reversing?
Please check if the camera's line is properly connected to the car radio. Note:The video port of rear camera must insert the "CAMIN" port of car radio.

4.Why does the camera display "!" and "Can't watch video while driving" when I use USB to watch videos?
Please turn off the "Video Warning" function in the settings,then will be OK.

5.Why can't search FM?
5.1: No radio antenna inserted;
5.2: Please check if the radio antenna is plugged in. Please insert more antennas several times to make it well contacted;
5.3: The signal of your location is not good. Please go to a better place to test again
5.4: The radio antenna on the car is broken/no effect; please replace the radio antenna and test again.

6.Why can't connect the Bluetooth of car radio?
6.1.Open the phone settings interface, open the Bluetooth in the Bluetooth function, search for Bluetooth devices, find the player's Bluetooth model to be paired; if you need a pairing code, enter 0000; if not, try 1234 or 123456.
6.2.Please try to use another mobile phone to test this function. Please check if the Bluetooth receiving antenna is properly connected All methods are correct and still cannot use Bluetooth, Please unplug the plug on the back of the player and plug it in after 3 minutes.

7: Bluetooth signal is weak, WiFi signal is weak:
please check and reconnect the Yellow rear Camera input connector, there are 2 short cables, they are the extension cords of the Bluetooth antenna and the WiFi antenna, or you can extend them to enhance the signal.

8: The navigation map does not work,
check whether the GPS has a signal, click GPS signal detection, if there is a signal, then reinstall a new map or open the mobile WiFi hotspot. If there is no GPS signal, leave the garage and test the GPS interface voltage on the road. The voltage must be 3.3V, otherwise the GPS antenna should be replaced.

9: The screen display is abnormal,
click the one-key recovery button, if it can't be solved, remove the screw on the back, check whether the screen cable is loose, and reconnect the screen cable.

10: Abnormal sound:
1 Check whether the original car cable has been modified by another car owner. If so, please check the speaker cable and reconnect it.
2 Check whether there is an original car or a modif

11:The radio cannot be turned on
11.1. The condition for the radio to turn on is that ACC (G3) and 12V (G2) are connected to the positive pole of the car's 12V power supply, and G1 is connected to the negative pole of the power supply. There may be a very small probability that the power cord does not match your car. You can directly connect these 3 power cords Connect the power cord of the car without the radio
11.2. It may be that the connecting wire of the radio came off during transportation, just open the back cover to check and reconnect the connecting wire inside the radio

11.3. If you can't turn on after checking the above steps, please send a video to us for confirmation. The video needs to show that the power cord is normally connected, and test the connection cord with an electric meter to be 12V.

FAQ:
1. How can I determine if my car model is suitable?
Please click on the product link to view the page and confirm the model year first. Check if the central control image of the car matches your vehicle and the attentions in the page. If it is suitable, please feel assured to make the purchase. If you are unable to confirm, please contact our customer service for assistance.

2. Why can't turn on the car radio?
2.1 Please check the Voltage of car radio: 12V
2.2 When you test this car radio, you can combine the red and yellow wires and connect them to the positive side of the power supply. Black line to negative power supply.
2.3 Replace the same type of insurance to test the car radio. Note: Please must use our power cables to connect our car radio, it is not possible to insert the original car plug directly into our machine.

3. Why will the car radio show 'No Signal' when we are reversing?
Please check if the camera's line is properly connected to the car radio. Note: The video port of the rear camera must insert the 'CAMIN' port of the car radio.

4.Why does the camera display "!" and "Can't watch video while driving" when I use USB to watch videos?
Please turn off the "Video Warning" function in the settings, then it will be OK.

5.Why can't search FM?
5.1: No radio antenna inserted;
5.2: Please check if the radio antenna is plugged in. Please insert more antennas several times to make it well contacted;
5.3: The signal of your location is not good. Please go to a better place to test again.
5.4: The radio antenna on the car is broken/no effect; please replace the radio antenna and test again.

6.Why can't connect the Bluetooth of car radio?
6.1.Open the phone settings interface, open the Bluetooth in the Bluetooth function, search for Bluetooth devices, find the player's Bluetooth model to be paired; if you need a pairing code, enter 0000; if not, try 1234 or 123456.
6.2.Please try to use another mobile phone to test this function. Please check if the Bluetooth receiving antenna is properly connected. All methods are correct and still cannot use Bluetooth, please unplug the plug on the back of the player and plug it in after 3 minutes.

7: Bluetooth signal is weak, WiFi signal is weak:
please check and reconnect the Yellow rear Camera input connector, there are 2 short cables, they are the extension cords of the Bluetooth antenna and the WiFi antenna, or you can extend them to enhance the signal.

8: The navigation map does not work,
check whether the GPS has a signal, click GPS signal detection, if there is a signal, then reinstall a new map or open the mobile WiFi hotspot. If there is no GPS signal, leave the garage and test the GPS interface voltage on the road. The voltage must be 3.3V, otherwise the GPS antenna should be replaced.

9: The screen display is abnormal,
click the one-key recovery button, if it can't be solved, remove the screw on the back, check whether the screen cable is loose, and reconnect the screen cable.

10: Abnormal sound:
1 Check whether the original car cable has been modified by another car owner. If so, please check the speaker cable and reconnect it.
2 Check whether there is an original car or a modif

11: The radio cannot be turned on.
11.1. The condition for the radio to turn on is that ACC (G3) and 12V (G2) are connected to the positive pole of the car's 12V power supply, and G1 is connected to the negative pole of the power supply. There may be a very small probability that the power cord does not match your car. You can directly connect these 3 power cords to connect the power cord of the car without the radio.
11.2. It may be that the connecting wire of the radio came off during transportation, just open the back cover to check and reconnect the connecting wire inside the radio.

11.3. If you can't turn on after checking the above steps, please send a video to us for confirmation. The video needs to show that the power cord is normally connected, and test the connection cord with an electric meter to be 12V.

  • Model: Designed for Honda CR-V 2006-2011.

  • Format and construction: 2 Din, QLED touchscreen of 9", ABS + QLED materials, weight 2 kg.

  • Operating system: Android, smooth and multilingual interface (more than 40 languages including Spanish, English, French, Portuguese, German, Italian, Arabic, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Greek, etc.).

  • Processor and memory: Chipset 7862/TS10/T5, processor 4/8 cores, RAM 8 GB, internal storage ROM 32/64/128/256 GB, compatible with external memory up to 256 GB (TF/MicroSD).

  • Screen: QLED resolution 2000×1200 or 1280×720, vivid colors and excellent visibility in any condition.

  • Audio: Output power 4×45 W, advanced DSP processor, high-fidelity sound output.

  • Connectivity:

    • Built-in WiFi.

    • 3G and 4G support.

    • High-quality Bluetooth for hands-free calls and music.

    • Wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay.

    • Voice control.

  • Special features:

    • Integrated GPS with updatable navigation.

    • Input for rear camera.

    • Split screen function for multitasking.

    • Steering wheel control support.

    • Built-in microphone and speaker.

    • Charger and compatibility with mobile phones and MP3 players.

    • Remote control included.

  • Radio and tuner: FM/AM, high-quality DSP tuner, preset stations.

  • Certifications and warranty: CE, FCC, RoHS, 2 years warranty.

  • Power Supply: 12 V automotive standard.

  • Installation: Plug & play interface, easy mounting in Honda CR-V 2006-2011 with full Can-Bus integration.

Imagine driving along the coast, the sun setting, and your CR-V transformed with this 9” QLED screen. Your favorite music plays with crisp, immersive sound, the GPS guides you accurately, and you respond to messages without taking your hands off the wheel. Suddenly, every journey is no longer a routine: it becomes a connected, safe, and stylish trip, because your car reflects who you are and what you enjoy.

autoradio-android-9-2din-para-bmw-serie-.source:
Convierte cada trayecto en una experiencia premium con esta autoradio inteligente, diseñada para modernizar tu BMW y ofrecerte seguridad, conectividad y entretenimiento sin límites.

Compatibilidad específica: Diseñada para BMW Serie 1 E87, E81, E82, E88, modelos 2004–2011. Asegúrate de revisar el marco (20,5 cm) y el tipo de climatización (manual o automático) para elegir la versión correcta (A o B).

Sistema operativo: Android 13, ágil y personalizable. Soporte para futuras actualizaciones OTA (firmware, UI, mapas).

Procesador: Potente chipset MTK de 8 núcleos AMP7388 con velocidad de hasta 2.0 GHz.

Memoria: 4 GB de RAM + 128 GB de almacenamiento interno. Soporta memoria externa hasta 256 GB vía microSD.

Pantalla: Pantalla táctil IPS de 9" con resolución 1280x720 (HD), colores vivos, alto contraste y modo día/noche automático.

Interfaz de usuario: Personalizable con temas Junsun UI. Función Split Screen: usa dos apps simultáneamente (ej. navegación + música).

Bluetooth 5.0: Conexión estable para llamadas manos libres y música. Captura de voz nítida.

WiFi y 4G integrados: Conectividad completa para navegación, streaming, y descarga de apps desde Google Play.

CarPlay y Android Auto inalámbricos: Usa tu móvil de forma segura: llamadas, música, mapas, mensajes, todo con comando de voz (Siri o Google Assistant).

GPS y navegación: Mapas online y offline (Google Maps, Waze, HereWeGo). Actualizaciones de mapas gratuitas de por vida.

Audio premium: DSP integrado con ecualizador gráfico de 12 a 48 bandas. Potencia de salida 4x45W. Calidad de sonido ajustable a tu gusto.

Radio FM/RDS: Chip de sintonización profesional (4745/MT6625N), señal estable incluso en movimiento.

Cámara trasera y ADAS: Entrada para cámara de reversa con visión clara en tiempo real. Soporte para cámara ADAS, grabadora DVR, TPMS, OBD2 (opcionales).

Micrófono y altavoz integrados: Preparado para comandos por voz y llamadas claras sin necesidad de dispositivos externos.

Conectividad física: 2 puertos TF/microSD, entrada/salida USB y RCA, AV-Out, salida óptica/coaxial (según versión), interfaz CAN-Bus.

Control desde el volante: Compatible con mandos originales. Configuración rápida desde interfaz dedicada.

Diseño y materiales: Estructura de composite resistente. Certificaciones CE, FCC, RoHS, EAC, KC, WEEE.

Funcionalidades exclusivas Junsun:

Anti-robo con seguimiento GPS desde app móvil.

Alarma por perímetro geográfico (geofence).

Control remoto (con dashcam opcional): historial de rutas, grabación, monitoreo.

Instalación fácil: Cableado pin-to-pin, sin cortes. Compatible con servicio de instalación en varios países (Europa, Medio Oriente, Norteamérica).

Garantía: 3 años. Devolución gratuita y servicio posventa 24h.

Entrega rápida: Envío en 24h desde almacenes en España, Francia, Alemania y Polonia.

Cuando compró su BMW, lo hizo por su elegancia, potencia y clase. Pero con los años, el sistema de entretenimiento se volvió anticuado.       Certifications: CE and FCC.
